name: Bangladesh Government Common Office
description: Office furniture, stationery, ICT, printing, networking, phones, meeting equipment, electrical supplies, cleaning, dining and pantry, safety, first aid, security, books, periodicals, curtains, decorative plants, trunks, safes, storage, maintenance, vehicles, vehicle tools and spares.
